source_title: The Galaxy S26 FE : The Fans’ Concert Phone of Choice, Packed with Ultra Camera Capabilities - Samsung Global Newsroom
source_excerpt:
From belting out your favourite chorus to catching that unforgettable moment when your favourite artist takes the stage, concerts are all about memories worth reliving. And with a stellar line-up dotting a busy season of concerts in Malaysia like Dato’ Sri Siti Nurhaliza and BTS bringing fans together, Malaysia’s concert scene is giving music lovers plenty to look forward to.
But while the live experience is unmatched, capturing it on your phone is a different story. Dim lighting, artists performing from a distance and the excitement of singing, dancing and jumping along can make getting that perfect shot a challenge. Nobody wants to look back at their concert gallery only to find blurry videos, grainy photos or footage that shakes with every beat.
Enter the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, a smartphone built on the Galaxy S Series’ camera DNA to help fans capture more of the moments that make live music special. With its powerful camera capabilities, ProVisual Engine and Super Steady Video with Horizontal Lock, it gives concertgoers more ways to bring home the sights, sounds and excitement of a night to remember.
Never Lose Sight of Your Favourite Moments
On an action-packed stage, you might lose focus on your favourite artists. Fortunately, the Galaxy S26 FE also features a My FanCam 1 , a game changer in creating your favourite concert content. A feature introduced with the latest Galaxy Z8 Series, My FanCam lets you keep focus on who you want, always helping you get the shot you want.
Jump, Sing and Dance. Let Super Steady Handle the Action.
A concert is not exactly the place to stand perfectly still. You are singing along, jumping to the beat, waving your hands and reacting to every surprise on stage. Trying to record all that excitement while keeping your phone steady can be a challenge in itself.
With Super Steady 2 Video, the Galaxy S26 FE helps you capture smoother footage while you move with the music. Its Horizontal Lock feature combines expanded optical angles with gyro and acceleration sensors to recognise the direction of gravity and keep your video level, even when you rotate the phone through a full 360 degrees.
That means you can focus on enjoying the moment without worrying quite as much about every movement affecting your footage. From recording an energetic chorus to capturing the crowd singing in unison, Super Steady Video helps keep your memories smoother and easier to watch back.
When the Lights Go Down, Your Camera Should Step Up
Concerts are a visual spectacle, from dramatic spotlights sweeping across the stage to colourful LED displays illuminating the arena. Yet, these atmospheric lighting conditions can be challenging for smartphone cameras, often resulting in grainy images or lost details just when the show gets good.
The Galaxy S26 FE helps make those after-dark memories worth keeping, with low-light capabilities designed to produce clearer, brighter photos and videos while reducing noise and preserving important details. Whether it is the anticipation before the opening act, a sea of fans waving their light sticks or the emotional finale of a favourite song, you can capture the atmosphere without letting the darkness steal the moment.
Powered by Samsung’s ProVisual Engine 3 , the Galaxy S26 FE enhances image quality and helps preserve detail across a wide range of shooting situations. The result? Sharp details, vibrant colours and lifelike clarity, with less effort required from you. So, when the stage lights hit and the crowd erupts, you can spend less time worrying about your camera settings and more time enjoying the show.
Whether you are seated in the upper tiers or standing among thousands of fans, your favourite artist can sometimes feel a little too far away.
That is where the Galaxy S26 FE’s 50MP camera and zoom capabilities come into play. Designed to help preserve details, textures and colours, its high-resolution camera gives you more flexibility to capture the action on stage, from an artist’s signature outfit to those expressive moments between songs.
Instead of settling for a distant figure surrounded by bright lights, you can bring more of the performance into focus and capture photos that help you relive the experience. It is especially useful when your favourite singer hits that iconic note, your favourite band launches into its biggest anthem or the entire arena lights up for a crowd-favourite song.
The Galaxy S26 FE also brings AI experiences closer to home for Malaysian users. Samsung is expanding Galaxy AI language support to include Malay across features such as Call Assist, Note Assist, Interpreter and Transcript Assist, making it easier to translate conversations, interpret notes, and work across voice recordings in a language Malaysians use every day. Now Nudge also adds Malay language support, helping users get relevant suggestions based on what is on their screen. It’s another step by Samsung towards making AI more accessible and useful in daily life.
